subject: MAP Weekly: Finalizing credits & commitment size for SynthGear
messages:
From: Priya Desai <priya@synthgear.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@synthgear.com>
Date: 2026-08-30T09:00:00-07:00
Subject: MAP update & final credit ask

Thanks Jordan — quick note from Procurement. We're aligning internal finance this morning and need a firm number for credits and an indication of the minimum commitment SynthGear would need to sign off by next week.

Current constraints: we have limited headcount to support a long pilot and need a 6-month plan with a single committed spend number. Can you send the MAP with the credit ask and recommended commit sizing? Also include any required internal approvals at Redwood we should expect.

Thanks,
Priya Desai
Head of Procurement
SynthGear
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Desai <priya@synthgear.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-30T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP update & final credit ask

Priya — thanks for the note. Attaching a MAP draft and a pricing worksheet for clarity. High-level proposal below:

- Recommended commit: $180k over 6 months (predictable reserved capacity for steady inference needs).
- One-time onboarding credit: $25k (applied to first invoice).
- Volume credit: 12% off list if commit is executed before 2026-09-10.
- Additional 30k free token credit for eval/test traffic during onboarding window.

Action items I will own: finalize the MAP PDF, confirm exact billing cadence with Finance, and route the discount for approval this morning.

Attachments: synthgear_map_draft_v2.pdf, pricing_proposal_v3.xlsx

If that sizing looks off your side, tell me today and I can propose a revised tier.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-30T09:25:00-07:00
Subject: RE: MAP update & final credit ask

Jordan — quick internal. The ask (25k onboarding credit + 12% volume) is within Ops guardrails but I need Finance confirmation on how the onboarding credit is recognized across invoices (credit vs prepaid). Laura, can you confirm acceptable billing treatment and whether we need a rev deferral note?

Also tagging Vivek for approval on the 12% off list for a $180k commit (that equals ~21.6k in discount). If we want to be conservative, we could propose $160k with a 14% credit instead.

Neha
Senior Sales Operations Manager
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-30T09:40:00-07:00
Subject: RE: MAP update & final credit ask

Neha/Jordan — finance sign-off with conditions:

- Onboarding credit ($25k) should be applied as a one-time invoice credit on month 1 and recognized as a contra-revenue (we'll record deferral if revenue recognition policy requires). We don't require prepaid for onboarding credit.
- Volume credit (12%) is acceptable for a $180k committed ARR equivalent, provided the SOW includes a termination/usage clause (60-day notice) and a minimum quarterly billing floor.
- Requesting billing cadence to be quarterly for this customer to simplify collections.

If legal requires different language, loop Karthik, otherwise I can sign-off and provide bill-to instructions.

Laura
Director, Finance Ops
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-30T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: RE: MAP update & final credit ask

Quick legal note: please include the following in the SOW/MAP before sending to SynthGear for signature:

- Billing cadence (quarterly) and the minimum quarterly billing floor amount.
- Explicit definition of onboarding credit and how it applies to the first invoice.
- Usage overage rates and the fallback model when reserved capacity is exceeded.
- Standard termination clause with 60 days notice and pro-rata settlement for unused committed credits.

Once Jordan gets a final MAP PDF with those points summarized, I can clear the SOW language.

Karthik
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Desai <priya@synthgear.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>

- Commit: $180,000 over 6 months (quarterly billing).
- Onboarding credit: $25,000 applied to first invoice.
- Volume discount: 12% off list if signed by 2026-09-10.
- Additional 30k tokens credited for evaluation window.

Next steps:
1) I will upload a MAP PDF to the shared link and open a DocuSign envelope with the SOW that includes the billing cadence & termination language Karthik requested (link below).
2) Please confirm signoff window — if SynthGear can confirm by Friday 2026-09-03 we will hold pricing and credits.
3) Neha/Laura/Vivek will process internal approvals for the 12% credit and quarterly billing.

DocuSign (draft): https://docusign.com/s/synthgear-sow-draft
Shared MAP draft: https://redwood-docs.internal/synthgear-map

Thanks — let me know if you need the numbers split per quarter for your CFO.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
